---
title: "Outreach"
---

I enjoy explaining how the brain learns to see to audiences outside the lab.
Most of these are science slams: short, funny talks for a general audience.

## Science slams and public talks

- **"Welchen Fernsehsender empfängt das Babyhirn?"** Geistesblitze Science Slam of the
  German Neurological Society (DGN), Volksbühne Berlin, March 2026.
  [Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qsCoXrlOMro) ·
  [Event report](https://hirnstiftung.org/geistesblitze-science-slam-2026/)
- **How the brain learns to see.** Flash talk at *Frankfurt hat Hirn*, a public
  neuroscience evening organised by the Hertie Foundation, March 2026.
  [Report](https://fias.institute/en/news/news-publicity/how-our-brain-works-a-night-long-experience/)
- **Ferrets in a cinema: early visual cortex development.** Science Slam at Haus am Dom,
  Frankfurt, February 2026.
- **How the brain finds the right chords.** First Oberursel Science Slam, November 2025.
  [Press](https://www.taunus-nachrichten.de/oberursel/nachrichten/oberursel/erster-oberurseler-scienceslam-vereins-kunstgriff-id216522.html)

## Scientific talks online

- *Experience drives the development of novel, reliable cortical sensory representations
  from endogenous networks.* Bernstein Conference 2022, Berlin.
  [Video](https://vimeo.com/showcase/9828727/video/749854704)

## Organising

- **German Neuroscience Olympiad**, national final in Frankfurt, since 2019. Outreach
  and press contact, grading coordination, computational tutorial. The winner goes on to
  the International Brain Bee.
- **PhD symposium** at FIAS following the Bernstein Conference 2024, co-organiser.
